summary: Altman expects widely shared AI to bring abundance and faster science, and argues that safety and alignment must stay ahead of capabilities.

statements.quote: Pacing will be well worth this cost; no amount of American competitive pressure should justify recklessness, or let capabilities get ahead of alignment and monitoring.
AI will be the most powerful tool for expanding human capability and potential that anyone has ever seen.
AI has to be democratized; power cannot be too concentrated.
In the 2030s, intelligence and energy—ideas, and the ability to make ideas happen—are going to become wildly abundant.
We do need to solve the safety issues, technically and societally, but then it’s critically important to widely distribute access to superintelligence given the economic implications.
